# Knowledge (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The knowledge base: ingesting documents, splitting them into passages, keyword and meaning search, and retrieval checks.

## Files

- `kb-routes.ts`: The knowledge base API: browse what the agents can draw on, search it the way an agent does, upload the client's own documents, and set up or test meaning-based search.
- `kb.ts`: The knowledge base: trusted text the agents must ground their drafts in.
- `retrieval.ts`: Retrieval checks (v1.6): does the knowledge base find the right passage for a question?

## Routes

Full detail, with request fields, in [`docs/API.md`](../../../../docs/API.md).
